page.overview:
Who is Hannah Diamant?

Hannah was a short girl with a small build. She had long light hair tied back with a hair tie, and freckles on her cheeks. She wore the typical uniform of the 104th Training Corps.

Hannah was a bright, cheerful girl, shown when she happily agreed with Franz Kefka that hopefully the Titans would not return. However, she appeared very shaken when Trost District fell as she accepted comfort from Franz. She became very frantic and delusional when Franz died and she constantly attempted to resuscitate him with CPR despite him being torn in half.

Hannah is first introduced as a newly-graduated member of the 104th Training Corps. During the night of graduation party, Franz and her attempt to calm Jean, who was fighting with Eren.

They later join him for a walk in Trost District. Hannah mentions that everyone has cheered up since the fall of Wall Maria. Franz then states that hopefully the Titans will not come back due to the reinforced cannons and Hannah happily agrees. In response, Eren teases them about being a couple. Both blush in embarrassment and deny being in a relationship.
